name: cpp-fuzzing
description: One property function reused by every kind of C++ check, as three skills and a working starter: one-property-many-checks (unit tests, AFL++ and compile-time undefined-behaviour checks share one constexpr property), compile-time-corpus-and-exhaustive (#embed corpus replay and bounded-exhaustive static_asserts with budget and memory guidance), afl-harness (replay-and-AFL++ harness, Docker recipe, time-boxed campaign, crash triage).
